name: Augury Point
source:
Your Uncle mysteriously died and left you a coffee shop in Augury Point, a middle-of-nowhere piece of desert populated by both humans and anthropomorphic animals. Saying that you're excited to save your late Uncle's sinking business would be an absolute lie: locals don't take kindly to outsiders, and your only employee is a useless conspiracy nut.

Even worse still, your Uncle's death appears to be highly suspicious, and the local police are of no help. Something dark stirs within the dusty streets of this small town, something that goes far beyond murder. 

To unveil this enigma, you can only rely on yourself and the help of your friends - a socially awkward witch, a prophet of the doomsday cult, an elder god, and the guy who cleans floors in your shop. The ultimate team.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2657430/Augury_Point/]Steam[/url]]
